screen.openwac.keyboard.title: Keyboard capture active
screen.openwac.keyboard.hint: Escape releases the keyboard unless captured. With Alt capture off, press Alt to walk and Alt again to resume. Moving over 8 blocks away disconnects.
screen.openwac.keyboard.suspended: Keyboard suspended. Press Alt to resume; moving over 8 blocks away disconnects.
message.openwac.keyboard.disconnected: OpenWAC: connect the keyboard to a powered computer with a Peripheral Port first.
message.openwac.keyboard.busy: OpenWAC: keyboard capture is busy. Only one player can use a keyboard at a time.
message.openwac.wire.selected: OpenWAC: selected %s. Click the other endpoint to link or unlink.
message.openwac.wire.linked: OpenWAC: wire linked. A Peripheral Port is required; reboot one-shot BIOS tests to rediscover devices.
message.openwac.wire.unlinked: OpenWAC: wire link removed. Adjacent devices can still connect automatically.
message.openwac.wire.cleared: OpenWAC: removed %s saved wire links from this computer.
message.openwac.wire.expired: OpenWAC: selected endpoint is unloaded, replaced, or in another dimension. Select it again.
message.openwac.wire.too_far: OpenWAC: endpoints must be within %s blocks. The first endpoint remains selected.
message.openwac.wire.invalid: OpenWAC: click a computer case or external peripheral, such as a TTD.
message.openwac.wire.different_kinds: OpenWAC: a wire must connect one computer to one peripheral. Selection updated.
message.openwac.wire.denied: OpenWAC: you cannot modify links at this endpoint.
message.openwac.wire.full: OpenWAC: this computer already has %s wire links. Unlink one or crouch-click the case to clear them.
message.openwac.wire.instructions: OpenWAC: click a computer and a peripheral in either order. Crouch-click the case to clear its links; crouch-use in air to cancel selection.
message.openwac.kernel_install_failed: OpenWAC kernel installation failed: %s. See server log for details.
message.openwac.crash_report: OpenWAC computer crashed: %s. See server log for details.
